notes.title: Update 2.2 Is here!
notes.content:
Caribbean Crashers - Update 2.2 Patch Notes

Ahoy, Crashers!

We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and we’re excited to bring you this latest update packed with improvements based on your suggestions!

What's New:

Level Completion Check: We've added a new check after completing each level to ensure all your progress is accurately tracked and recorded. This should make your gameplay smoother and more reliable, allowing you to enjoy the journey without any hiccups.
Bug Fixes & Improvements:

Bug Fixes: We’ve squashed some pesky bugs that were causing issues in the game.
Performance Enhancements: Various optimizations have been made to improve overall game performance and stability.
Minor Tweaks: Adjustments have been made to certain gameplay elements to enhance your experience.
Brand Update:

Rebranded Patch Notes: Along with these updates, we’re excited to introduce a fresh new design for our patch notes to better align with the Bloxhill brand. We hope you enjoy the new look!
Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We’re committed to making Caribbean Crashers the best experience possible. Keep the feedback coming, and we'll keep improving!

notes.title: 2.0 IS OUT!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the highly anticipated 2.0 update is now live on Steam! Get ready to embark on a thrilling adventure with a plethora of exciting new features waiting for you. and let's just say, there are a lot of them.

Set sail starting May 10th, and experience the excitement for yourself! 

Here's some of the things you can expect to see! 

-Dynamic Physics Interaction:

Implemented dynamic physics interactions where hitting objects that support characters will cause them to fall, enhancing realism and interactivity within the game environment.

-Additional Levels:

Added several new levels to provide players with more challenges and gameplay variety. Progression system ensures players must complete previous levels to unlock subsequent ones.

And more!

If you wish to read more feel free to head over to our in depth patch notes page by going here: https://www.bloxhill.com/caribbean-crashers/v2-0

We can't wait to see you on board!
